history.p: "Knud Lavard" became one of Gade's most popular songs. The 1848 manuscript, which he donated to his later brother-in-law, the composer and pianist August Winding in 1859, differs from the 1849 version and the printed score concerning key and opening bars..

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in cardboard cover with library label. Written in ink. Paper: 20 staves. Heading on fol.1r: "Magnus og Knud Lavard. (C. Hauch)". At the bottom of fol.1r: "Min kjære August Winding / fra hans Ven og hengivne / Niels W. Gade. December 1859." After the final bar on fol.2r: "1848" and Gade's musical signature. Fol.2v blank.
